channel.title: Showcase tools on jMonkeyEngine
channel.description: Recent content in Showcase tools on jMonkeyEngine

item.title: EnvisionPlay
item.description: EnvisionPlay is a visual game editor designed to make creating 2D and 3D games simple and accessible. It provides an intuitive workflow that allows developers to focus on building gameplay instead of writing boilerplate code.

item.title: Nostr Game Engine
item.description: A game engine and framework for building games and applications integrated with the Nostr ecosystem.

item.title: Exotic Matter Engine
item.description: A custom voxel/sandbox engine and technology stack built around jMonkeyEngine for the Exotic Matter project.

item.title: jMonkeyEngine SDK
item.description: NetBeans-based development environment for jMonkeyEngine projects: templates, scene tooling, asset workflow helpers, and desktop project setup.

item.title: Maud
item.description: A dedicated editor for jMonkeyEngine 3D models, focused on inspecting and editing assets outside the game runtime.

item.title: SceneMax3D
item.description: A desktop-based game development environment designed around a visual workflow and a custom scripting language.
